Marissa —

Appreciate the clear MAP. procurement@acmeanalytics.com is the right alias (we use that for vendor invites). A couple notes from my side after checking with AP: 

1) We prefer supplier onboarding via Ariba. I’ll have our supplier enablement team generate an invite once we provide the basic paperwork (W-9 + vendor form).
2) We do require bank details (ACH) and a signed vendor form — that’s pretty standard. No additional security questionnaire for platform vendors under $250K ARR, but if procurement flags anything we’ll circle back.
3) Target timeline looks realistic; our blocker is getting the vendor invite into Ariba — that’s on our side to initiate once we receive the paperwork.

I’ve looped in procurement@acmeanalytics.com on this thread so AP can pick up the vendor forms.
